name: agent-context-pruner
description: Replaces Claude Code's compaction summary with decision-model pruning: stale tool calls and results are dropped or truncated, everything kept stays verbatim.

provider.title: Decision model provider
provider.description: auto: TypeSafe when TYPESAFE_API_KEY or an API key is set, then Cloudflare when CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN and an account id are set, else the rules-based model (no network).

model.title: Model name
model.description: Leave empty for the provider's default: jev-latest (typesafe), clef (cloudflare), nimble (ollama).

apiKey.title: API key
apiKey.description: Key for the chosen provider. Leave empty to use TYPESAFE_API_KEY or CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN from the environment.

keepThreshold.title: Keep threshold
keepThreshold.description: A tool call or result stays when the model's keep score reaches this. Lower keeps more. model default uses the provider's calibrated value.

compactAtPercent.title: Auto-compact at context %
compactAtPercent.description: After a turn, compact once context use reaches this percentage. off leaves compaction to /compact and Claude Code.

preCompactHooks.title: PreCompact hooks
preCompactHooks.description: run: Claude Code's classic PreCompact hooks (ECC's pre-compact, your own) still run, at the cost of one small summary request. skip: faster, those hooks do not run.

preserveRecentMessages.title: Recent messages to protect
preserveRecentMessages.description: The newest messages are never pruned. Each tool call and its result count as separate messages.

minReductionRatio.title: Minimum reduction
minReductionRatio.description: When pruning removes less than this share of the transcript, Claude Code's built-in summary runs instead.

truncateHeadChars.title: Truncated result length
truncateHeadChars.description: Characters kept from the start of a truncated tool result.

noteDroppedCalls.title: Note dropped calls
noteDroppedCalls.description: Leave a one-line note where a dropped call's result was, so the model knows what was removed and can re-run it.

fallbackToHeuristic.title: Fall back to the rules-based model
fallbackToHeuristic.description: When the chosen model is unavailable or fails, prune with the rules-based model instead of going straight to Claude Code's summary.

logEachDecision.title: Log every decision
logEachDecision.description: Print each scored call's keep scores after a compaction. Off prints one summary line.

baseUrl.title: Server URL
baseUrl.description: ollama and custom only: the server root, for example http://localhost:11434. /v1/systemone is appended.

accountId.title: Cloudflare account id
accountId.description: cloudflare only. Leave empty to use CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID.
